narration.id: Bismillah… yuk mulai! Pagi cerah di rumah. Ezra bangun tidur. Kak Qila menyapa: "Assalamualaikum!"
narration.en: Bismillah… let's begin! Bright morning at home. Ezra wakes up. Big sister Qila greets: "Assalamualaikum!"

praise.id: Selamat pagi, Ezra! Ayo belajar salam.
praise.en: Good morning, Ezra! Let's learn to greet.

narration.id: Ezra mencoba: "Assalamualaikum, Ayah! Assalamualaikum, Bunda!" Senyumnya lebar, lesung pipitnya muncul.
narration.en: Ezra tries it: "Assalamualaikum, Dad! Assalamualaikum, Mom!" His smile grows — dimples pop!

narration.id: "Kakak bilang Assalamualaikum," kata Qila. "Kamu jawab: Waalaikumsalam!" Ezra riang menjawab. Tepuk tangan!
narration.en: "I say Assalamualaikum," says Qila. "You answer: Waalaikumsalam!" Ezra answers with a giggle. Clap clap!

praise.en: High five! Your answer is amazing!

narration.id: Ezra jalan dengan Ayah ke musala. Qila ikut di samping. Tangan di dada, Ezra menyapa tetangga: "Assalamualaikum!"
narration.en: Ezra walks with Dad to the musala. Qila walks along. Hand on heart, Ezra greets the neighbours: "Assalamualaikum!"

praise.id: Tangan di dada, senyum di wajah!
praise.en: Hand on heart, smile on your face!

narration.id: Di tempat main ada teman baru! Lili menunggu, Ezra malu berbisik. "Ezra, jangan berbisik! Ucapkan jelas!" kata Qila.
narration.en: At the play spot — a new friend! Lili waits; Ezra whispers, shy. "Ezra, no whispering!" says Qila. "Say it clearly!"

praise.id: Qila cerewet tapi sayang Ezra, ya?
praise.en: Qila nags, but she loves Ezra!

narration.id: Ezra menarik napas: "Assalamualaikum!" "Waalaikumsalam!" jawab Lili riang. Teman baru! Lesung pipit Ezra bersinar.
narration.en: Ezra takes a breath: "Assalamualaikum!" "Waalaikumsalam!" Lili beams back. New friends! Ezra's dimples shine.

narration.id: Salam menjalar di seluruh kampung! Toto, Nana, dan Momo ikut tersenyum. Satu sapaan, hati semua damai.
narration.en: The salam travels all around the kampung! Toto, Nana, and Momo smile too. One hello — peaceful hearts everywhere.

narration.id: "Tahu arti salam?" tanya Qila lembut. "Assalamualaikum artinya semoga keselamatan untukmu." Salam itu doa damai untuk teman.
narration.en: "Do you know what salam means?" asks Qila. "Assalamualaikum means peace be upon you." It is a small prayer of peace.

praise.id: Doa damai untuk teman, ayo diucapkan!
praise.en: A prayer of peace — say it kindly!

narration.id: Sekarang giliranmu! Ayo ucapkan: "Assalamualaikum!" Ezra dan Qila menunggu sapaanmu.
narration.en: Now it is your turn! Say it with Ezra: "Assalamualaikum!" Ezra and Qila wait for your hello.

narration.id: Malam tiba. Alhamdulillah, hari yang manis! Ezra menatap kamu: "Assalamualaikum!" Lesung pipitnya berkedip. Sampai jumpa!
narration.en: Night comes. Alhamdulillah, sweet day! Ezra looks at you: "Assalamualaikum!" His dimples wink. See you soon!

hikmah.id: Salam bukan sekadar kata — "Assalamualaikum" artinya semoga keselamatan untukmu.
hikmah.en: Salam is more than a word — "Assalamualaikum" means peace be upon you.

prompts.id: Siapa yang akan kamu sapa dengan salam hari ini?
prompts.en: Who will you greet with salam today?
What is the right reply to a salam?

prompts.id: Bagaimana rasanya hatimu saat disapa salam?
prompts.en: How does your heart feel when greeted with salam?
